name: hiveku-hooks
description: Hiveku's hooks for Codex, installed beside the hiveku plugin: a check, when a session starts, that the hiveku server has an account key (HIVEKU_TOKEN is set, or the folder's own Codex config carries one), and a reminder to save a website change as a version before the agent finishes. Codex asks you once to trust them.

interface.shortDescription: Hiveku's session check and version reminder for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Works with the hiveku plugin. When a session starts it checks that the hiveku server has an account key (HIVEKU_TOKEN is set, or the folder's own Codex config carries one) and repeats Hiveku's working rules. While the agent works it notes which website projects changed, and before the agent finishes it asks once for a version of any change that is not one yet. It also stops a hiveku_batch that carries a tool Codex asks you about, so you are asked about that call on its own. This plugin changes only when these hooks change, so a new tool on the hiveku plugin's ask list does not ask you to trust the hooks again.
